# Basalt

> Dense, dark, durable. A matte design system for information-rich software.

Basalt is the matte React design system `@nocoo/basalt` and its public catalog.
Public pages welcome search engines and AI crawlers. This file, the sitemap,
and the catalog list do not require JavaScript.

## Catalog

- [Design system catalog](https://basaltui.com/ui): Components, charts and blocks
- [Full catalog list](https://basaltui.com/llms-full.txt): One entry per published surface
- [App frame](https://basaltui.com/layout): Shell, island and page heading recipe
- [Login](https://basaltui.com/login): Full-viewport identity badge

## Package

- npm: [@nocoo/basalt](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@nocoo/basalt)
- Repository: [github.com/nocoo/basalt](https://github.com/nocoo/basalt)
- Agent usage guide (installed package): `ai/USAGE.md`
- Application chrome: `ai/INTEGRATION.md`
- Compilable recipes: `ai/RECIPES.md`
- Machine registry: `ai/registry.json`
